items.t: Rear fuel tank can leak after a rear crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect rear structure and install factory tow hitch
items.note: Free inspection and hitch work under recall 13V-252. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Clicking behind the dash and wrong air temperature
items.job: Replace blend or mode door actuator
items.note: If the blend door itself is broken, the dash may have to come out and the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Power window drops or stops working
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor
items.note: Price is per door.

items.t: Airbags may go off without a crash (recall)
items.job: Install airbag control module jumper harness
items.note: Covered free under recall 12V-527. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Front seat heater can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat heater elements
items.note: Covered free under recall 09V-117. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: No-crank from wireless control module
items.job: Replace and program the wireless control module
items.note: Used modules cost less but still need programming to the vehicle and keys.

items.t: A/C water can get into the transmission (recall)
items.job: Replace fill tube seal and add water deflector
items.note: Covered free under recall 05V-396. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer. Cost rises a lot if the transmission was damaged.

items.t: Transfer case can slip into neutral (recall)
items.job: Reflash transfer case control software
items.note: Covered free under recall 13V-175. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Knee can bump the key and shut off the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch
items.note: Covered free under recall 14V-438. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Brake pedal can disconnect from booster (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster input rod retaining clip
items.note: Covered free under recall 10V-009. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Rear track bar problem (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear track bar
items.note: Covered free under recall 10V-085. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Key can come out before shifting to Park (recall)
items.job: Replace wireless ignition node (WIN) module
items.note: Covered free under recall 10V-200. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Stalling or no-start from fuel pump relay (recall)
items.job: Install external fuel pump relay and wiring
items.note: Covered free under recall 19V-813. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer. Replacing the whole TIPM costs more.

items.t: Left cylinder head wear on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace left cylinder head
items.note: FCA extended coverage on many 2011-2013 left heads. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer first.

items.t: Oil filter/oil cooler housing leak on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly
items.note: Plastic housings crack again; many shops use an updated or aluminum housing.

items.t: Ticking from worn rocker arms on the 3.6L V6
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lash adjusters on one cylinder head
items.note: Price is for one cylinder head. A worn camshaft adds a lot to the cost.

items.t: Alternator failure can cause stalling (recall)
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Covered free under recall 14V-634. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Confusing shifter can lead to rollaway (recall)
items.job: Update shifter and transmission software
items.note: Covered free under recall 16V-240. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Diesel EGR cooler cracking (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR cooler
items.note: Covered free under recall 20V-699. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer. Intake manifold damage costs more.

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump failure (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Covered free under recall 22V-406. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer. Cost rises a lot if debris reached the injectors.

items.t: Fuel rail crossover tube may leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel rail crossover tube
items.note: Covered free under recall 16V-814. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: EGR valve can stick open (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR valve assembly
items.note: Covered free under recall 22V-284. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Rear coil spring can come loose (recall)
items.job: Replace rear coil spring lower isolators
items.note: Covered free under recall 26V-562, which replaces earlier campaigns. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Front upper ball joint can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace front upper control arm pinch bolts
items.note: Covered free under recall 24V-132. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: 4xe high-voltage battery fire risk (recall)
items.job: Update high-voltage battery software
items.note: Free under recall 25V-741, including a battery if needed. Park outside and do not charge until done.

items.t: Electronic throttle control light and sudden loss of power
items.job: Replace the electronic throttle body
items.note: Pedal and throttle sensors should be tested first; cleaning alone rarely holds.
